# vrx CLI — command reference

<!-- GENERATED by apps/cli (go run ./cmd/vrx-docgen) from the command registry and the OpenAPI operation table. Do not edit. -->

`vrx` is the on-box command line of VRX: operational `show` commands and a configuration mode with
candidate → commit/confirm → rollback semantics. It is a thin client of **vrx-api** (`/api/v1`): every command
below lists the REST operations it calls (from the OpenAPI document), and the CLI never talks to vrx-agent or VPP.

## Starting

| invocation | what it does |
|---|---|
| `vrx` | interactive shell (terminal): history, Tab completion, `?` help |
| `vrx <command …>` | one command, then exit (configuration commands work directly: `vrx set …`, `vrx commit`) |
| `vrx configure <command …>` | one configuration-mode command (e.g. `vrx configure show interfaces` shows the candidate) |
| `vrx --json <command …>` | machine mode: stdout carries exactly one JSON document (the API's answer); on failure stderr carries one `{"error":{exitCode,status,message,problem}}` document |
| `vrx < script` | commands from stdin, one per line (no prompts); stops at the first failure with its exit code |

### Flags and environment

| flag | env | meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `--api <url>` | `VRX_API_URL` | API base URL, default `http://127.0.0.1:3000` |
| `--api-key-file <path>` | `VRX_API_KEY_FILE` | API key from a file that only its owner can read (0600); `VRX_API_KEY` carries the key itself |
| `--user <name>` | | log in for this invocation; the password is prompted without echo (or `--password-file <path>`, 0600) |
| `--no-session` | | neither read nor write the session file |
| `--json` | | machine mode (see above) |
| `--debug` | | method, path, status and duration of every API call on stderr — never headers, bodies or credentials |
| | `VRX_SESSION_FILE` | session file, default `$XDG_RUNTIME_DIR/vrx/session.json` |
| | `VRX_HISTORY_FILE` | REPL history, default `~/.local/state/vrx/history` (0600; lines mentioning password/secret/psk/keys are not saved) |

### Credentials

Order: `--api-key-file` → `VRX_API_KEY` → `--user` → session file → (interactive shell) login prompt.
`vrx login` stores only the 15-minute access token in the 0600 session file; the interactive shell keeps the refresh
token in memory and renews the access token on a 401. Passwords and keys are never echoed, logged or written to
history. `api-key create … file <path>` writes a new key to a new 0600 file instead of printing it.

## Paths and values

A configuration path is a list of words; each word is exactly one JSON-pointer segment of the configuration schema
(the mapping is 1:1): `interfaces TenGigabitEthernet0/0/0 mtu` ⇔ `/interfaces/TenGigabitEthernet0~10~10/mtu`.
A single word starting with `/` is a JSON pointer itself (absolute, also below an `edit` level); `..` climbs one level.
Array items are addressed by index (`routing static 0 prefix`).

Values are checked against the live JSON Schema (`GET /api/docs-json`) **before** any request: type, range, enum,
length and pattern. Words are converted by the schema type (`9000` → integer, `true` → boolean); quote a word to keep it
a string; `{…}` / `[…]` are JSON. On a list of scalars (addresses, names) `set` appends one item and
`delete <path> <value>` removes it. `merge <path> <json>` is an RFC 7386 merge patch (`null` deletes a member).

Output formats of configuration: `text` (default: a stable brace hierarchy, keys sorted, one leaf per line), `set`
(one `set` command per leaf — the commands that rebuild it), `json`. Diffs are printed as `- set …` / `+ set …` lines.

## Operational commands

| command | description | REST |
|---|---|---|
| `api-key create <name> [role admin\|operator\|readonly] [expires <days>] [file <path>]` | Create an API key (shown once; with `file` it is written to a new 0600 file instead) | `POST /api/v1/auth/api-keys` · *operational* |
| `api-key delete <id>` | Revoke an API key | `DELETE /api/v1/auth/api-keys/{id}` · *operational* |
| `api-key list` | Your API keys (never the key itself) | `GET /api/v1/auth/api-keys` · *operational* |
| `commit [confirm <sec>] [comment <text>]` | Apply the candidate atomically; with `confirm <sec>` the change reverts unless `confirm` follows in time | `POST /api/v1/config/commit` · *both* |
| `configure` | Enter configuration mode (one-shot: `vrx configure <config command>`) | local: switches the shell mode; the candidate lives in the API · *operational* |
| `confirm` | Confirm the pending commit (cancels the auto-revert and records the revision) | `POST /api/v1/config/commit/confirm` · *both* |
| `delete <path> [<list-value>]` | Remove the node at a path from the candidate (with a value: remove that item of a list of scalars) | `DELETE /api/v1/config/{path}`<br>`GET /api/v1/config/candidate/{path}` · *both* |
| `discard` | Drop the candidate and release the lock | `POST /api/v1/config/discard` · *both* |
| `help [<command>]` | List commands, or explain one | local · *both* |
| `login [<user>]` | Log in (password prompted without echo); one-shot use stores the 15-min access token in a 0600 session file | `POST /api/v1/auth/login` · *operational* |
| `logout` | Revoke the refresh token (interactive) and remove the session file | `POST /api/v1/auth/logout` · *operational* |
| `merge <path> <json-object>` | RFC 7386 merge patch at a path (null deletes a member); the merged result is schema-checked first | `PATCH /api/v1/config/{path}`<br>`PATCH /api/v1/config`<br>`GET /api/v1/config/candidate/{path}`<br>`GET /api/v1/config/candidate` · *both* |
| `ping <host>` | Ping from the data plane (the API answers 501 until the agent implements actions) | `POST /api/v1/actions/{action}` · *operational* |
| `rollback <rev> [confirm <sec>] [comment <text>]` | Apply an old revision as a new revision | `POST /api/v1/config/rollback/{rev}` · *both* |
| `set <path> <value>` | Set the value at a path in the candidate (value checked against the schema first); on a list of scalars it appends | `PUT /api/v1/config/{path}`<br>`GET /api/v1/config/candidate/{path}` · *both* |
| `show bgp summary` | BGP neighbour summary | no REST endpoint yet: the API has no BGP state route (FRR state arrives with P12) — exits 10 · *operational* |
| `show commit pending` | The confirmed commit waiting for `confirm`, if any | `GET /api/v1/config/commit/pending` · *operational* |
| `show configuration [<path>] [json\|text\|set]` | Running configuration (redacted), whole or at a path | `GET /api/v1/config`<br>`GET /api/v1/config/{path}` · *operational* |
| `show configuration candidate [<path>] [json\|text\|set]` | Candidate configuration (what `commit` would apply) | `GET /api/v1/config/candidate`<br>`GET /api/v1/config/candidate/{path}` · *operational* |
| `show configuration diff` | Uncommitted changes: candidate vs running, as - / + set lines | `GET /api/v1/config/diff` · *operational* |
| `show drift` | Running configuration vs what the agent retrieves from the data plane | `GET /api/v1/state/drift` · *operational* |
| `show interfaces [<name>]` | Interfaces as retrieved from VPP by the agent, with counters | `GET /api/v1/state/interfaces` · *operational* |
| `show ip route [<vrf>]` | Routes retrieved from the data plane (connected + static), optionally of one VRF | `GET /api/v1/state/routes` · *operational* |
| `show ipsec sa` | IPsec security associations | no REST endpoint yet: the API has no IPsec SA state route (P11) — exits 10 · *operational* |
| `show lock` | Who holds the candidate (single writer) | `GET /api/v1/config/lock` · *operational* |
| `show revision <rev> [json\|text\|set]` | One revision with its (redacted) configuration | `GET /api/v1/config/revisions/{rev}` · *operational* |
| `show revisions [<count>]` | Commit history, newest first | `GET /api/v1/config/revisions` · *operational* |
| `show system` | API and agent health, running revision, pending commit, running↔data-plane sync state | `GET /api/v1/state/system` · *operational* |
| `show whoami` | The authenticated user, effective role and credential type | `GET /api/v1/auth/me` · *operational* |
| `traceroute <host>` | Traceroute from the data plane (the API answers 501 until the agent implements actions) | `POST /api/v1/actions/{action}` · *operational* |
| `validate` | Three-tier validation of the candidate (schema → semantic → agent dry-run); nothing is applied | `POST /api/v1/config/validate` · *both* |

## Configuration-mode commands

| command | description | REST |
|---|---|---|
| `compare` | Uncommitted changes (same as `show configuration diff`) | `GET /api/v1/config/diff` · *configuration* |
| `edit <path>` | Move the edit level (later paths are relative to it; a path starting with / is absolute) | local (the path is checked against the schema) · *configuration* |
| `exit` | Leave configuration mode (the candidate stays until commit/discard) | `GET /api/v1/config/diff` · *configuration* |
| `show [<path>] [json\|text\|set]` | Candidate configuration at the edit level or a path | `GET /api/v1/config/candidate`<br>`GET /api/v1/config/candidate/{path}` · *configuration* |
| `top` | Move the edit level to the top | local · *configuration* |
| `up` | Move the edit level up one element | local · *configuration* |

In configuration mode all commands marked *both* above are available too, `show` means the candidate at the edit level, and `run <command>` runs an operational command.

Commands available in both modes are listed under *Operational commands*. Words may be abbreviated to a unique prefix (`sh int` = `show interfaces`).

## Exit codes

| code | meaning |
|---|---|
| 0 | success |
| 1 | unexpected error (bug, malformed answer) |
| 2 | usage error: unknown command, bad arguments, or a value rejected by the client-side schema check (nothing was sent) |
| 3 | not authenticated: no credentials, wrong password, expired session (HTTP 401) |
| 4 | permission denied by RBAC (HTTP 403) |
| 5 | not found: nothing at that path, no such revision (HTTP 404) |
| 6 | conflict: candidate locked by another user, no pending commit to confirm, … (HTTP 409) |
| 7 | rejected by the API's validation (HTTP 400, problem+json with pointers) |
| 8 | commit or rollback failed and was rolled back; running unchanged (HTTP 422) |
| 9 | API unreachable, agent unavailable, or outcome unknown — check `show system` sync state (HTTP 502/503/504/500) |
| 10 | not implemented yet by the API/agent (HTTP 501 or no REST endpoint) |
| 11 | login rate limit (HTTP 429) |

## Not in this release

- Login-shell / SSH wiring and a local unix-socket transport with peer-credential check (P13 out of scope; the API
  listens on TCP only today): the CLI authenticates with a login or an API key.
- `show bgp summary` and `show ipsec sa` exist but exit 10: the API has no BGP / IPsec SA state endpoints yet.
- `ping` / `traceroute` call `POST /api/v1/actions/{action}`, which answers 501 until the agent implements actions.
